title: R6 v1: API решателя с числом потоков (свой rayon-пул на вызов)
goal: Функция библиотеки picard_rs::api::solve(case, &SolveOpts{threads, max_iters}) строит свой rayon::ThreadPool на вызов (threads = 0 — все логические ядра), глобальный пул не трогает; CLI solve/bench — тонкая обёртка над ней; тест: одновременные вызовы с разным числом потоков дают те же итерации и поля.
scope: tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/src/main.rs — solve/bench через api::solve, своя функция pool() уходит в api
tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/README.md — раздел «API (R6)»: сигнатура, пример вызова, поведение threads = 0
tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/src/report.rs — только доработка: фазы (R2 v2 time.phase_ms) передавать через Solved/Timing, убрать перенос через последнюю запись history (временный обход PR-1)

accept.name: clippy
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-2 --no-tmux -- cargo clippy --manifest-path tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings

accept.name: blocks_dev
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-2 --no-tmux -- cargo run -q --manifest-path tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/Cargo.toml -- blocks tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/flat_wind.json tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/agnesi.json tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/heated_slope.json tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/saddle.json

accept.name: solve_ref_release
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-2 --no-tmux -- bash -c 'set -e; for c in flat_wind agnesi heated_slope saddle; do tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/release/picard solve tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/$c.json --threads 8 --out tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_${c}_release_t8.json; done' && python3 tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/contract/tolerance.py tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_flat_wind_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_agnesi_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_heated_slope_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_saddle_release_t8.json

accept.name: solve_ongudai_release
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-2 --no-tmux -- bash -c 'set -e; for c in ongudai_d400_u3_heat ongudai_d400_u3_mech ongudai_d400_u0_heat ongudai_d400_u6_heat; do tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/release/picard solve ~/data/air_cascade/ongudai/$c.json --threads 8 --out tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_${c}_release_t8.json; done' && python3 tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/contract/tolerance.py --iters-tol 10 tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_ongudai_d400_u3_heat_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_ongudai_d400_u3_mech_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_ongudai_d400_u0_heat_release_t8.json tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_ongudai_d400_u6_heat_release_t8.json

accept.name: test_api
accept.cmd: .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-2 --no-tmux -- cargo test --manifest-path tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/Cargo.toml --test api

accept.name: results_base_v2
accept.cmd: python3 tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/contract/check_contract.py --results tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/out/base/ && .dpcli/dpcli lock cpu PR-2 --no-tmux -- tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/release/picard solve tests/atmosphere/fixtures/air_model/ref/saddle.json --threads 0 --out tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_saddle_t0.json && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('tools/research/air_cascade/picard_rs/target/check_saddle_t0.json')); print('v', d['version'], 'threads', d['threads'], 'phases', len(d['time']['phase_ms']), 'hist_phase', sum('phase_ms' in h for h in d['history']))"

report_extra: api: сигнатуры pub из api.rs одной строкой каждая
test_api: что проверяет tests/api.rs (случаи, потоки, одновременность)
cli_same: R2 через CLI до/после — итерации и dev совпали (ref/ 8 потоков)
